crossRefs.note: Samuel called the people together to Yahweh to Mizpah;
“Go down ahead of me to Gilgal; and behold, I will come down to you, to offer burnt offerings, and to sacrifice…
He sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of cattle to…
They sacrificed sacrifices to Yahweh, and offered burnt offerings to Yahweh, on the next day after that day, even one…
But the people refused to listen to the voice of Samuel; and they said, “No; but we will have a king over us,
Now therefore see the king whom you have chosen, and whom you have asked for. Behold, Yahweh has set a king over you.
Isn’t it wheat harvest today? I will call to Yahweh, that he may send thunder and rain; and you will know and see that…
Where is your king now, that he may save you in all your cities? And your judges, of whom you said, ‘Give me a king and…
I have given you a king in my anger, and have taken him away in my wrath.
But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.

people.name: Gilgal
people.line: A significant site during Israel's early history in Canaan.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: All the people went to Gilgal; and there they made Saul king before Yahweh in Gilgal. There they offered sacrifices of peace offerings before Yahweh; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly.
translations.bsb: So all the people went to Gilgal and confirmed Saul as king in the presence of the LORD. There they sacrificed peace offerings before the LORD, and Saul and all the Israelites rejoiced greatly.
translations.kjv: And all the people went to Gilgal; and there they made Saul king before the LORD in Gilgal; and there they sacrificed sacrifices of peace offerings before the LORD; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly.
translations.asv: And all the people went to Gilgal; and there they made Saul king before Jehovah in Gilgal; and there they offered sacrifices of peace-offerings before Jehovah; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly.
